name: Analyze specific scenarios using ethical frameworks
description: Users asked the AI to analyze specific scenarios, professional cases, or real-world events through the lens of ethical principles, philosophical theories, and moral obligations. They sought detailed evaluations of dilemmas in fields such as business, healthcare, technology, and public policy, often requiring the application of specific frameworks like utilitarianism or deontology to justify decisions or critique actions.
